chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمْرَانَ النَّهْدِيُّ وَجَمِيلُ بْنُ دَرَّاجٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Muḥammad ibn Ḥumrān al-Nahdī and Jamīl ibn Darrāj asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: عَنْ إِمَامِ قَوْمٍ أَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ فِي السَّفَرِ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ مَا يَكْفِيهِ لِلْغُسْلِ أَيَتَوَضَّأُ بَعْضُهُمْ وَيُصَلِّي بِهِمْ

translations.en: About an Imam of a people who is affected by janābah during travel, and he does not have enough water with him for ghusl; should one of them perform wudu and lead them in salat?

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ «لَا وَلَكِنْ يَتَيَمَّمُ الْجُنُبُ وَيُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ جَعَلَ التُّرَابَ طَهُورًا كَمَا جَعَلَ الْمَاءَ طَهُورًا».

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: “No. Rather, the junub should perform tayammum and lead them in salat, for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has made earth a means of purification just as He has made water a means of purification.”

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tayammum when a person in janābah lacks sufficient water for ghusl during travel. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that the junub should perform tayammum and may lead the congregation in salat, since Allah has made earth a valid means of purification like water.
en.seo_question: Can a junub who does not have enough water for ghusl perform tayammum and lead the prayer while traveling?

key_terms.جَنَابَةٌ: a state of major ritual impurity requiring ghusl
key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel, the circumstance in which the ruling is being asked about
key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: the person in a state of janābah
